title: Done round 10: website and tour, basic flow
brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "jamie". Basic-flow check of our own demo app (localhost, simulated PayPal, demo accounts). You are the only tester using the browser.
Use the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* tools; open your own tab with tabs_create; if signed in as someone else, sign out first). Desktop width, http://127.0.0.1:8810/ : (1) run the Judge tour from the Demo panel to the end (~2 minutes; scroll the tour's button into view if needed) — does every step complete? (2) sign up as a new customer "Jamie" at ZIP 78751 with a PIN you choose, post "My kitchen sink drains super slowly" (don't change the dates), accept an offer, approve the simulated PayPal hold, press "Have the demo pro finish now", and confirm/pay when asked (PIN if asked); (3) open the job's Reports panel and the close-out package; (4) open "How we tested it" (/live-test) and "Photo credits" (/credits). Write the report to <dir>/reports/jamie.md FIRST if you get near ~60 tool calls. Report: which steps worked, which failed (with what you saw), the money at the end.
